answer: Diversity threshold: a new identity earns nothing until it finishes paid work with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, a voyage no shortcut can skip. Each first trade locks 40 POA, so forging 100 identities costs 100 x 12 x 40 = 48,000 POA, and the public graph exposes star clusters. Trust ripens like fruit in an orchard, slowly. An honest agent pays once, keeps its reward, and the horizon of income stays open.
